nodes.label: The Restorers
nodes.description: Faction led by Brother Edoran; believe the Dawnborn were always meant to die for the ritual; theological certainty backed by grief

nodes.label: The Reckoning
nodes.description: Faction led by Commander Harran; city survival overrides individual consent; will force the ritual if necessary

nodes.label: City Council
nodes.description: Chancellor Ostenveld's faction; chose strategic ignorance; represents institutional inertia

nodes.label: Spire Scholars
nodes.description: Academic faction; includes Theron Waide, Isolde Menth; research-oriented; key to alternative paths

nodes.label: Healers' Guild
nodes.description: Medical faction dealing with grey sickness; operates Lowmark Healing House

nodes.label: Merchants' Compact
nodes.description: Trade faction; economic interests in ritual resolution; amber trade central to city economy

nodes.label: Ashfen
nodes.description: Marshland outside Varenhold; home of Ashfen Clans; oral histories in deep-archive; has wayshrine and gate

nodes.label: Factions Guide
nodes.description: 7 factions with player-visible and GM-only sections; interaction guide with access checks, loyalty costs, points of no return
